aggregate-summary.description: The shape of `fdu --view summary`: five exact tallies, no snapshot. It reads .gitignore by default, which before fdu-1ovb retained the index to classify entries and since then classifies them in the transient aggregate plan; with --no-controls it is that plan without classification, the tier closest to the machine floor.

default-tree.description: The default command over an unchanged tree with a snapshot present, as a session or `--cache on` leaves one. `prepare_report` does not read the snapshot for a metadata query, so this is a cold scan plus whatever the run does with the file it finds; `snapshot_written` in the probe summary says whether it rewrote it. The job the two default-path defects are judged on.
